permissionsActions.items.privacySettings.issue: Inconsistent terminology. 'Definições' is common in Portugal, while 'Configurações' (used in other entries) is common in Brazil. Given the overall Brazilian Portuguese informal register, 'Configurações' should be used for consistency.
permissionsActions.items.privacySettings.suggested: Configurar Configurações de Privacidade e Partilha

permissionsActions.items.manageAccess.ti.issue: Inconsistent terminology. 'Gerir' is common in Portugal, while 'Gerenciar' is common in Brazil. Given the overall Brazilian Portuguese informal register, 'Gerenciar' should be used for consistency.

permissionsActions.items.apiKeysAccess.d.issue: Inconsistent verb form. 'Gere' is the informal imperative (você/tu) of 'gerir' (PT-PT), while 'Gerencie' is the equivalent for 'gerenciar' (PT-BR). Given the overall Brazilian Portuguese informal register, 'Gerencie' should be used for consistency.
permissionsActions.items.apiKeysAccess.d.suggested: Gerencie as integrações de apps de terceiros e o acesso à API

permissionsActions.items.auditLogs.title.issue: Inconsistent terminology. 'Registos' is common in Portugal, while 'Registros' is common in Brazil. Given the overall Brazilian Portuguese informal register, 'Registros' should be used for consistency.

permissionsActions.items.auditLogs.descr.issue: Inconsistent terminology. 'Rasto' is common in Portugal, while 'Rastro' is common in Brazil. Given the overall Brazilian Portuguese informal register, 'Rastro' should be used for consistency.
permissionsActions.items.auditLogs.descr.suggested: Revisa o histórico de acesso e o rastro de auditoria de segurança
